title: Password Age Concentration by Category
dataSources: Breach alerts (`hibp:alert`), password age snapshots (`passwordage:account`), backup restore tests (`backuprestore:test`), and DNS leak checks (`dnsleak:check`).
app: Personal security telemetry from Have I Been Pwned, password-age exports, backup restore drills, and DNS leak checks sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=passwordage:account
| stats avg(days_since_rotation) as avg_days_since_rotation sum(days_since_rotation) as total_age_days by account_category
| sort 0 - avg_days_since_rotation
description: Ranks account categoriess by password age concentration.
value: Age concentration by category helps you choose one cleanup campaign that will actually retire a meaningful slice of risk.
implementation: Send password age concentration events to `index=personal` and keep `account_category` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of password age concentration by account categories.
grandmaExplanation: It turns which account categoriess stand out most for password age concentration.
